summary: Final exact-SHA review of 96945d2e closed the five prior findings but found two behavioral regressions in legacy activation-event gating/no-op ordering and confirmed a repository envtest harness should cover stored v0.6.4 status migration.
validation: Reviewer confirmed prior duplicate/mismatch, Work-state, generation, and deletion findings are closed
blockers: Legacy activation-event candidacy intercepts modern/unclassifiable activations before request classification, changing established missing/mismatch/Active behavior.
Already-terminal legacy requests are checked after linked-activation validation, so duplicates or mismatch can replace the required no-op.
No legacy stored-object migration test uses the repository's available envtest harness and real status-subresource/resourceVersion behavior.
Pipeline loop budget is exhausted at 6/6; further code transition requires human escalation.
next_action: Obtain explicit human authorization to start a fresh bounded remediation pipeline, then fix modern-path gating/no-op ordering and add an envtest migration case before another exact-SHA review.
